title: How today's brass bands compare; music with names cut off
summary: Dejan compares old and current bands' repertoire, and describes cutting the titles off music so hired players call tunes by number.

story.theme_name: Where jazz stands today: young players, rock, and the audience
story.community_name: Is jazz healthy? Young players, rock and the future
